principles: one canonical evidence path per gate
documentation does not authorize production deployment or external outreach
umbrella and focused branches must not be merged blindly
legal tax privacy and source-rights conclusions require their own qualified sign-off where applicable

closeCriteria: canonical migration and final release manifest

items.topic: Corporate structure and IP chain of title
closeCriteria: executed company rights transfer or licence structure

items.topic: Company-controlled digital assets, accounts, recovery and secrets
OSS, dependency, SBOM, licences and AI asset DD
closeCriteria: exact-head SBOM/licence and supply-chain QA green

items.topic: Source rights, data transferability and commercialization rights
closeCriteria: launch-critical RED/review replacement or documented carve-out

items.topic: GDPR, privacy operations, retention, DPA and analytics consent
closeCriteria: consent/withdrawal UX and release evidence where required
Works DPIA screen before personal-data launch

items.topic: Platform architecture, buyer DD and technical transferability
evidence: Lifestyle PR #1 green Platform-Core consumer QA
Works PR #3 code-contract adoption with browser CI gate open
closeCriteria: non-founder technical handoff drill for founder-independence claim
use focused current gate PRs for final merge/evidence decisions
reconcile any unique evidence before closing or superseding the umbrella branch

g1ReadyRule.rule: G1 may be declared ACQUISITION_CLEAN only when every non-reference item is DONE, all exact-head evidence is archived, known exceptions/carve-outs are explicit, and no required legal/privacy/tax/source-rights sign-off remains pending.

mergeHygiene: rebase or rebuild focused candidate on current main before final merge if branch divergence is material
do not merge overlapping umbrella and focused PRs without diff reconciliation
record which PR supersedes which earlier candidate
rerun evidence after dependency or runtime changes
buyer data-room status must reference the actually merged/acquired state, not a historical green branch
